_about: Illustrative inputs, not measured in this experiment: the break-even formula of the report applied to data-centre servers on a coding workload. Read by analysis/make_analysis.py, which writes the results to results/numbers.json under server_examples. Added 2026-11-16.
usd_per_eur_source: European Central Bank, euro reference rate of 2026-11-11
colocation_source: CBRE (2026), European data centre press release, Global Data Center Trends 2026: Frankfurt up to EUR 225 per kW and month for a 250-500 kW requirement; a lower bound for a single server

servers.name: 8× B200 server
servers.price_source: Exxact TensorEX 8U HGX B200 Server (TS4-142487900), configured price, 2026-11-16: 8x HGX B200 180 GB, 2x EPYC 9554, 1,536 GB
servers.idle_source: ServeTheHome (2025), ASRock Rack 8U8X-GNR2 SYN B200 review: just over 2.9 kW at idle with 10 NICs
servers.colocation_kw_source: the same B200 server under max load, just over 12.5 kW (ServeTheHome 2025)

servers.name: 8× B300 server
servers.price_source: Supermicro eStore, SYS-822GS-NB3RT (8x HGX B300, 2.3 TB HBM3e), system starting price, 2026-11-16
